title: Escalation triage queue
description: Scores incoming work, routes it to the correct owner, and escalates critical items.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: escalation-triage-queue
  title: Escalation triage queue
  description: Scores incoming work, routes it to the correct owner, and escalates critical items.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Ensure urgent and high-impact issues receive timely, accountable handling.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 5
    onFailure: retry
    requireApprovalFor:
      - critical-escalation
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Incoming escalation queue
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - items
          - routingRules
          - sla
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: classify
      kind: agent
      name: Classify and score items
      role: Triage coordinator
      prompt: Score urgency, impact, risk, customer exposure, and required expertise. Recommend route and SLA.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - optimization
        tools:
          - read
          - classify
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: route
      name: Route by score and ownership
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Escalation routing coordinator
      prompt: Route each item by priority, required skill, accountable owner, and SLA. Preserve the scoring rationale and flag
        unowned or overdue work.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - optimization
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: critical
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Critical escalation gate
      role: Escalation evaluator
      prompt: Return failed when any item meets critical escalation criteria.
      config:
        threshold: 1
    - id: critical-escalation
      kind: approval
      name: On-call leader accepts critical escalation
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Routed triage queue and escalation log
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: classify
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: classify
      to: route
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: route
      to: critical
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: critical
      to: result
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e5
      from: critical
      to: critical-escalation
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e6
      from: critical-escalation
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
